title: Why distribute at all
introduced: Monorepo skeleton, architecture-as-code (ADRs, ADL, CALM), and BTC-USD live via CoinGecko.

title: Architecture as code
introduced: An interactive architecture explorer, reading the CALM timeline directly.

title: Data ownership and the first split
introduced: The price-snapshot service splits into a Prices Service and a Market History Service, each with its own database.

title: The order saga
introduced: An Orders Service, a workflow engine orchestrating the saga, and a Ledger Service owning balances.

title: The market open and the bill
introduced: A queue absorbs the market-open order burst; per-node cost starts appearing on the architecture itself.

title: What held, what broke
introduced: A Leaderboard Service, real Alpaca/Massive stock data, Stripe's role defined -- the retrospective part.
